name: Dual Station Metrology Rig
maturity: engineering design / no fabricated parts or qualified assembly
scope: Two independent instrumented frames connected by a manually-operated transfer rail for measurement controls. No electromagnetic portal, levitation or matter transfer capability claimed.

design_limits.supply: isolated USB / 5V maximum nominal at the concept stage; verify every interface before power
design_limits.load_cell_range_kg: 0–5 by selected sensor rating, not accuracy
design_limits.payload_nominal_grams: 20–250 subject to validated load cell and carriage ratings
design_limits.ring_effects: unpowered, replaceable architectural lighting only after independent electrical review
design_limits.portal_field: undefined; no experimentally established field-generation principle

stations.role: independent sensor platform at rail origin
independent sensor platform at rail destination

components.name: Extrusion chassis + leveling feet
components.specification: 20×20 mm T-slot extrusion; two station mounts and central rail anchors; verify cutting, brackets, bolt patterns and measured stiffness

components.name: Gate A and B modular annular frames
components.specification: OD 360 mm / ID 260 mm / nominal plate 18 mm; use 6 printable segments or CNC-cut annular plates; non-load-bearing optical/sensor mounts

components.name: Linear guide/rail and manually operated carriage
components.specification: 1200 mm dual guide nominal; manually operated carriage with 680 mm design travel, hard stops and strain relief; no motor at this stage

components.name: Payload tray and removable datum fixtures
components.specification: 100×130 mm carriage tray plus reference fixture; ensure sensor platforms are isolated from rail mechanical loading

components.name: Matched low-voltage load-cell assembly
components.specification: Manufacturer-documented 5 kg rated load cell with verified mechanical mounting; raw readings only until calibration

components.name: HX711 breakout, revision individually verified
components.specification: Confirm analog VCC, digital VDD and DOUT logic levels; NEVER tie 5V digital output to Pico GPIO

components.name: Raspberry Pi Pico 2 microcontroller
components.specification: MicroPython firmware with distinct A/B station ID, read-only PG1 USB frame output; 3.3V-safe GPIO

components.name: USB cameras with stable mount
components.specification: Known local USB camera devices, lockable mount, consented preview, bench JPEG recording; controlled exposure required for metrology

components.name: Diffuse low-intensity visible reference lamp
components.specification: Commercial low-voltage diffuse LED used as visual reference only, not a laser or experimental high-energy emitter

components.name: Transparent guard, manual hard stops and cable channel
components.specification: Covers pinch points and restricts access to moving carriage; manually operated; labelled access control

components.name: Windows workstation and isolated USB hub
components.specification: Run PhaseGate NEXUS native EXE; check USB camera bandwidth, permissions, clock limitations and disk capacity

components.name: Traceable calibration reference masses
components.specification: 3 or more standards with documented uncertainty, repeated trials, as-left/as-found and environmental notes

work_packages.name: Design freeze: dimensions, tolerances, loads
work_packages.acceptance: Review CAD clearances, inspect mounting tolerances and list deviations

work_packages.name: Safety and supply review
work_packages.acceptance: Qualified low-voltage electronics reviewer approves board revision, GPIO levels and isolation

work_packages.name: Fabricate two unpowered gate frames
work_packages.acceptance: Two independent stable frames, measured ID/OD, supported and square; no energized aperture

work_packages.name: Install carriage rail and passive controls
work_packages.acceptance: Pass manual motion/pinch clearance tests and rail hard-stop inspection

work_packages.name: Bring up isolated raw sensors at A/B
work_packages.acceptance: Bounded serial data and fault handling demonstrated with a known safe test load

work_packages.name: Characterize scale metrology
work_packages.acceptance: Independent reviewer evaluates bias, drift, hysteresis, noise and calibration range

work_packages.name: Attach consenting optical witness stations
work_packages.acceptance: Both images have unobstructed view of reference source; recorded time limitations declared

work_packages.name: Run blinded controls and manual-transfer baseline
work_packages.acceptance: Independent witness verifies conventional shuttle transfers vs no-move controls; no unsupported transport claim

work_packages.name: Physics feasibility research and falsifiable proposal
work_packages.acceptance: Scientific evidence supports testing a specific effect before any field-emitter prototype is commissioned

caveats: Dimensions are tentative prototype envelope values, not approved fabrication tolerances or procurement specifications.
Concept render shows idealized energetic apertures and speculative coil/power hardware; those portions are not included in the bench build.
No mechanical or electrical work is reported completed and no actual equipment has been acquired.
